question: Which transcription factors have cell type enriched RNA expression, and in which single cell types? Give the number of such transcription factors per cell type as a bar chart of the fifteen cell types with the most. For the cell type with the most, list its transcription factors with their nCPM, the distribution of their RNA tissue specificity categories as a bar chart, and which of them have a validated prognostic association in any TCGA cohort. Provide the table.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT DISTINCT \"Protein class\" FROM proteinatlas WHERE \"Protein class\" ILIKE '%Transcription%' LIMIT 50"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT DISTINCT \"RNA single cell type specificity\" FROM proteinatlas ORDER BY 1"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"RNA single cell type specificity\", COUNT(*) n FROM proteinatlas GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT Gene, \"RNA single cell type specific nCPM\", \"RNA tissue specificity\", \"RNA tissue cell type enrichment\" FROM proteinatlas WHERE \"Protein class\" ILIKE '%Transcription factors%' AND \"RNA single cell type specificity\"='Cell type enriched' LIMIT 20"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH tf AS (SELECT Gene, regexp_extract(\"RNA single cell type specific nCPM\", '^(.*):', 1) AS cell_type FROM proteinatlas WHERE \"Protein class\" ILIKE '%Transcription factors%' AND \"RNA single cell type specificity\"='Cell type enriched') SELECT cell_type, COUNT(*) AS transcription_factors FROM tf GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 15"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH n AS (SELECT Gene, \"RNA single cell type specific nCPM\" AS cell_type_nCPM, \"RNA tissue specificity\" AS tissue_specificity FROM proteinatlas WHERE \"Protein class\" ILIKE '%Transcription factors%' AND \"RNA single cell type specificity\"='Cell type enriched' AND regexp_extract(\"RNA single cell type specific nCPM\", '^(.*):', 1)='Neutrophils') SELECT n.Gene, n.cell_type_nCPM, n.tissue_specificity, COALESCE(string_agg(CASE WHEN c.\"validated prognostic - favorable\"='True' THEN c.Cancer || ' (favorable)' WHEN c.\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\"='True' THEN c.Cancer || ' (unfavorable)' END, '; ' ORDER BY c.Cancer), 'None') AS validated_TCGA_association FROM n LEFT JOIN cancer_prognostic_data c ON n.Gene=c.Gene GROUP BY n.Gene,n.cell_type_nCPM,n.tissue_specificity ORDER BY TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(n.cell_type_nCPM, '([0-9.]+)$', 1) AS DOUBLE) DESC, n.Gene"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH n AS (SELECT \"RNA tissue specificity\" category FROM proteinatlas WHERE \"Protein class\" ILIKE '%Transcription factors%' AND \"RNA single cell type specificity\"='Cell type enriched' AND regexp_extract(\"RNA single cell type specific nCPM\", '^(.*):', 1)='Neutrophils') SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n FROM n GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC, category"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT Gene, Cancer, \"validated prognostic - favorable\", \"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" FROM cancer_prognostic_data WHERE Gene IN ('ELF2','NFKBIZ','BCL6','STAT5B','ZNF438','ZNF429','ZNF281','ZNF746') AND (\"validated prognostic - favorable\" <> '' OR \"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" <> '') LIMIT 100"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_transcription_factors, COUNT(DISTINCT regexp_extract(\"RNA single cell type specific nCPM\", '^(.*):', 1)) AS n_cell_types FROM proteinatlas WHERE \"Protein class\" ILIKE '%Transcription factors%' AND \"RNA single cell type specificity\"='Cell type enriched'"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH tf AS (SELECT Gene, regexp_extract(\"RNA single cell type specific nCPM\", '^(.*):', 1) AS cell_type FROM proteinatlas WHERE \"Protein class\" ILIKE '%Transcription factors%' AND \"RNA single cell type specificity\"='Cell type enriched') SELECT cell_type, COUNT(*) AS n, string_agg(Gene, ', ' ORDER BY Gene) AS transcription_factors FROM tf GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cell_type"}
